title: Cost Register Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: One cost line: part of a wagetype's amount posted to a ledger account under a set of cost elements. A wagetype split across several wage accounts gives several lines, each carrying its cost percentage of the amount.

fields.label: CostRegisterId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Cost Register master data.
fields.html: What it is. The cost register this line belongs to.

fields.label: WageTypeId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wagetype costed. An arrear is costed under its source wagetype.

Example. Basic Salary

fields.label: AccountInfoId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Account Info master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The ledger account the amount posts to.

Example. 510100 — Salaries and Wages

fields.label: CurrencyId
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Currency master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The currency of the employee's basic pay.

Example. Kuwaiti Dinar

fields.label: CostElement1Id
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Cost Element master data.
fields.html: What it is. Cost element 1 — one of up to seven accounting dimensions, copied from the employee's wage account.
